verdict.rationale: Baseten's evidence only shows it exposing an MCP server so external coding agents can manage a Baseten workspace (baseten-docs-5, baseten-probe-4) — the reverse direction of this story, which asks whether a user can plug MCP servers INTO Baseten so it can use their tools. There is no evidence of Baseten supporting MCP client integration, tool/server configuration, or MCP-based tool consumption within its inference stack.
